title: Shadow's End | ECHO//100 Episode 29
description: Kavi confronts the living embodiment of the city's suppressed history as reality begins to rewrite itself. He must choose between total erasure and a dangerous, permanent integration of the truth. Episode 29 of ECHO//100: The City Without Shadows. AI-assisted original fiction.

scenes.text: Static consumes the horizon as the city shadows dissolve into absolute nothingness.
scenes.caption: Shadows turn to static
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing on a crumbling skyscraper ledge, watching the street-level shadows disintegrate into digital grey fuzz.

scenes.text: Null steps from the void, red eyes piercing the pale, manufactured morning light.
scenes.caption: Null reveals himself
scenes.image_prompt: The entity Null, a towering figure of black-purple glitching pixels with piercing red eyes, looming over Kavi on the city rooftop.

scenes.text: Null declares himself the truth buried beneath this fabricated, golden-hued history.
scenes.caption: Null speaks the truth
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of Null, his glitching face flickering as he gestures toward the city, his form shifting like unstable code.

scenes.text: Byte hovers nearby, cyan face pulsing with alarm as the city foundations crack.
scenes.caption: Byte monitors the decay
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, the white floating orb with an orange antenna, scanning the fracturing skyline with frantic cyan light pulses.

scenes.text: The city rejects Null, yet the new timeline requires his darkness to survive.
scenes.caption: Null demands a place
scenes.image_prompt: Null reaching out a clawed, pixelated hand toward Kavi, who clutches his backpack straps, looking conflicted and determined.

scenes.text: Kavi realizes deleting Null destroys the foundation, necessitating a weave of hidden truths.
scenes.caption: Kavi finds the solution
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi closing his eyes, holding his hands out toward Null, as orange data streams from his backpack merge with Null's dark void.

scenes.text: Energy surges through the streets, binding ancient, forgotten secrets to the new reality.
scenes.caption: Reality begins to merge
scenes.image_prompt: Bright light exploding from the junction of Kavi and Null, spreading outward to coat the buildings in a shimmering, dark violet energy.

scenes.text: The sky calcifies into deep black-purple, sealing the city under its eternal guardian.
scenes.caption: The sky turns permanent
scenes.image_prompt: A wide shot of the entire city now bathed in a permanent, ominous black-purple twilight, with Null’s silhouette etched into the clouds.
